name: Paladin's Horn: The Destiny of the Holy Lance
detailed_description:
With permission from the creator - Blueballs - I have given his character, Lance of Gran Campion, new life here within this visual. The creator has nothing to do with this product and its creation.

  • - - - - -

Within this title you will be able scavenge for items within the local wildlands, thereby allowing them to be crafted within the town from the local villagers. Such items will include everything from elemental stones which can become swords, armor and accessories, to herbs and fruits which can be mixed into healing reagents and status ailment restoratives. However, be warned that there are monsters within the wildlands, some of which include demons, as such, you will need to face them down in traditional turn-based combat, via games such as Final Fantasy and Dragon quest. 

All of this hard work and effort will be for the sake of the people of the village of Cotton Hill, the main 'hub' area of the game, as in building up yourself you will be able to help them with their daily tasks, of which include everything from cleaning up their respective businesses, to helping them to farm and grow the resources needed to provide for the community. In doing so you will grow your relationship them, the same as you would in games like Persona, and thereby go out on dates with them, boosting your intimacy levels until you can get in bed with you more favored character.

  • - - - - - -

In this iteration, Lance will be cast adrift upon the land of Eleazar, a kingdom like any other, what with its pompous nobles, unreachable king, unscrupulous bandits, and cheery townsfolks, not to mention the demons and monsters which lurk outside within the dark. All a standard affair for the world as it is today, however, Lance will find himself tempted and tested, both by his own code of ethics, and his desires for the many men who live within the village of Cotton Hill.

Between Russ, the country bumpkin of a farmer who is just trying to live his life without incidence, but finding harder and harder to do so, thanks to the machinations of the lord of the land constantly interfering with his.

Sen, Russ' mysterious cousin, a man who also happens to be related to the high ranking priest within the Gran Campion paladin order, and someone who seems to know more about what's going on within the shadows of Eleazar than he lets on whispering into Lance's ear.

Nibbles, the pub owner looking to expand outwards with the aid of those who are willing to invest within him and his business ventures seeking to mold Lance into a fighter, fit to take on some of the greatest warriors within the entire world. 

Victory, an appetizing exotic dancer from places unknown who carries more secrets behind the foxy smile that he wears than most people could imagine, drawing Lance into his web of conspiracy.

Hammer, the surly blacksmith who just wants to be left alone, but possesses a secret that could bring ruin to the town if left unchecked, and who Lance, as a stalwart paladin, will become encumbered by if allowed to be as such.Felix, the posh fashionista who has come to the village in order to get away from the tiresome tedium that is the lifestyle of the highbrow aristocrats, who he himself is a part of, that wants to use Lance as his personal model for his clothing line.

Whyte, a charmingly empathic healer whose golden eyes hide truths that he cannot tell the rest of the world for fear of what will happen to both himself and those who is he protecting looking up to Lance for comfort and aid.

And a chubby rabbit bandit who can either get on Lance's bad side because of his bad behavior, or his naughty side if the paladin decides to cross over onto the other side of the law...

All of these men, and the troubles that encompass their lives, will lead the stallion to question both himself and the oaths that he has taken, which will put the purity of his virtues to the test.

Worst still, is if Lance does let himself fall into the line of sin and debauchery, he risks creating a monster out of himself, one in which will threaten the entirety of the world that the six dragon gods have created, but only if the temptation of what is overcomes him.

Thankfully with your aid he will be able to resist this fate, after all, Lance needs to return to Gran Campion so that he can be with his best friend, Pike, a golden labrador from the far eastern lands who is worried sick about him!

short_description: Lance finds himself in a position to help the people in the village of Cotton Hill. In order to help these people Lance will need to defeat foes in turn-based combat, all the while crafting weapons and items to help him survive fighting the monsters within the wildlands he will scavenge items from.
